technical.summary: Early momentum divergence signals (PPO, OBV, Supertrend) show potential recovery, but price remains structurally weak below all major moving averages and cloud support with deeply negative MACD—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 29 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 small purchases) and disabled news data provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (378.4), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and earnings event in 29 days create a highly unfavourable risk environment for ACN.

debate.key_bull_argument: PPO crossover, rising OBV, and supertrend bullish signals combined with extreme fear sentiment (10/100) and proximity to support (257.98) offer contrarian entry for mean reversion play.
debate.key_bear_argument: Structural weakness across all major moving averages, deeply negative MACD, price below cloud, zero fundamental catalysts, high earnings risk in 29 days, and crisis-level VIX create an unfavourable risk/reward that negates early momentum divergence signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Early PPO/OBV divergence and price at support (257.98) offer contrarian setup, but structural weakness across all moving averages and deeply negative MACD lack sufficient confluence for conviction entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 29 days combined with crisis-level VIX (378.4) and macro recession signals create elevated volatility risk that could trigger sharp downside before momentum thesis plays out.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 3 other IT holdings in 18-position portfolio creates sector concentration; skip entry to avoid compounding exposure in unfavourable macro environment.
